hints.title: Adjacent Anagram Comparison
hints.text: Two words are anagrams if their sorted character representations or letter counts are identical.

hints.title: Sequential Preservation Criterion
hints.text: Keep the first word unconditionally. For every subsequent word, include it only if its sorted signature differs from the previously kept word.

hints.title: Single Pass Selection
hints.text: Iterate through words in order, comparing each word sorted key to the last retained word sorted key.

hints.title: Adjacent Anagram Elimination Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting characters of each word takes O(L log L).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated deletions on an array take quadratic time in list shifts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate observes that only consecutive adjacent anagrams are eliminated.
